## Library Loading

```{r}
#| message: false
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
```

Data paths:

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
```


## Reaing the files
## Augment donor metadata

### Read file

```{r}
donor_metadata <- read.csv(str_c(data_dir,"/03_donor_metadata_clean.csv"))

protein_df <- read.csv(str_c(data_dir,"/clean_protein_data.csv"))

rnaseq_df <- read.csv(str_c(data_dir,"/03_rnaseq_clean.csv.gz"))

rna_metadata <- read.csv(str_c(data_dir,"/_raw/rna_metadata.csv"))

```

## Augment donor metadata


### Generate groups for coloring

```{r}
donor_metadata <- donor_metadata |>
  mutate(group_colors=case_when(
    alzheimer=="yes" & num_tbi_w_loc==0 ~ "AD_noTBI",
    alzheimer=="yes" & num_tbi_w_loc!=0 ~ "AD_TBI",
    alzheimer=="no" & num_tbi_w_loc==0 ~ "noAD_noTBI",
    alzheimer=="no" & num_tbi_w_loc!=0 ~ "noAD_TBI",
  ))

```



## Augment protein data:

### Add groups to protein_df
```{r}
groups_lookup <- donor_metadata |>  #this lookup table allows to match each donor ID with its group
  select(donor_id, group_colors) |>
  distinct()

protein_df <- protein_df |>
  left_join(groups_lookup, by = "donor_id")
```


## Augment RNA-seq data:

### Add groups to rnaseq_df
```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |>
  left_join(groups_lookup, by = "donor_id") |>
  relocate(group_colors, .after = structure_acronym)
```


## Write augmented files

```{r}
metadata_file <- str_c(data_dir, "/04_donor_metadata_aug.csv")
write_csv(x = donor_metadata,
          file = metadata_file)

prot_file <- str_c(data_dir, "/04_aug_protein_data.csv")
write_csv(x = protein_df,
          file = prot_file)

rna_file <- str_c(data_dir, "/04_aug_rnaseq_data.csv.gz")
write_csv(x = rnaseq_df,
          file = rna_file)

```
